key.name: filter
key.description: A filter over the whole screen: protan and deutan pull reds and greens apart, tritan blues and yellows, grey takes the colour away. none turns colour filters off, and their tile goes from quick settings.

key.name: filter-on
key.description: The colour filter tile's switch: off keeps the filter chosen without drawing it.

key.name: filter-strength
key.summary: How strongly the colour filter works
key.description: In per cent of the full filter. The tile offers 50, 75 and 100.

key.name: ruler
key.description: A band that follows the pointer, the rest dimmed around it, or a line under it. off turns the ruler and its shortcut off.

key.name: ruler-shown
key.description: What the ruler's shortcut switches while a ruler is chosen.

key.name: ruler-key
key.summary: Show or hide the reading ruler
key.description: Bound only while a ruler is chosen.

key.name: read-aloud
key.description: While on, the shortcut reads the selected text aloud on this computer, with the voice the screen reader uses.

key.name: read-aloud-speed
key.summary: How fast the selection is read
key.description: About this many times the voice's normal speed.

key.name: read-aloud-key
key.summary: Read the selection aloud, or stop
key.description: Bound only while reading aloud is on.
